name: quick
description: A short guided tour that shows the core Prompt Vault Pro beta workflow with fictional demo content.

scenes.narration: Start in your library to see saved prompts, recent activity, and the place where reusable ideas stay organized.
scenes.caption: Open your prompt library.

scenes.narration: For beta sharing, use the app sign-in page so the tour stays privacy-safe and avoids exposing any personal account details.
scenes.caption: Share the safe sign-in view.

scenes.narration: Select New prompt, then add the Restaurant Menu Improvement title and paste the reusable prompt content for a fictional menu review workflow.
scenes.caption: Add a title and your reusable prompt.

scenes.narration: Save the prompt to confirm the detail view, the cleaned-up layout, and the ready-to-reuse instructions for future sessions.
scenes.caption: Save and review the prompt.

scenes.narration: Attach the fictional sample menu so the prompt and its supporting knowledge stay together for repeatable restaurant planning analysis.
scenes.caption: Pair the prompt with a sample menu.

scenes.narration: Finish with search to show how quickly the saved prompt comes back when someone needs it again.
scenes.caption: Find the prompt again in seconds.
